Short version: Meta kicked us off WhatsApp. So we built our own app, and you're invited.

Launching on WhatsApp was the best thing we'd done. It showed us how you actually want to use readywhen: you came back more often
and handed it more real jobs.
Then Meta banned us, and we don't know much about why. Classic David vs. Goliath.


So we built our own app

every response.

memorii.rezumat: Lipsa unui mecanism de salvare 'retry-with-backoff' și a unui handler de persistență în modulele critice de asimilare/vindecare, ducând la pierderea stării organelor în coadă la eșecul HTTP. → Implementarea unui decorator de tip 'persistentRetry' care utilizează localStorage ca buffer de siguranță pentru sarcini eșuate, garantând că starea nu este pierdută în caz de 500/503. | Patch aplicat în psie-arca: src/lib/hydraCore.js — commit 90723ab | SDI: 0.08
memorii.detalii:
CICLU AUTO-REPARARE

Diagnostic: Sistemul prezintă instabilitate în persistența stării unitare și erori repetitive de tip 500/503 în modulele de asimilare și vindecare (hydraVindecarePSIE, hydraInformaticaPSIE). Auditul arată că starea este calculată corect dar nu este ancorată persistent în registru, cauzând bucle de re-invocare eșuate.
Problema: Lipsa unui mecanism de salvare 'retry-with-backoff' și a unui handler de persistență în modulele critice de asimilare/vindecare, ducând la pierderea stării organelor în coadă la eșecul HTTP.
Soluția: Implementarea unui decorator de tip 'persistentRetry' care utilizează localStorage ca buffer de siguranță pentru sarcini eșuate, garantând că starea nu este pierdută în caz de 500/503.
Fișier: src/lib/hydraCore.js
SDI: 0.08 | Reversibilitate: 0.95

Execuție: Patch aplicat în psie-arca: src/lib/hydraCore.js — commit 90723ab

Patch:
const persistentRetry = async (taskName, fn, retries = 3) => { try { return await fn(); } catch (e) { if (retries > 0) { console.warn(`Reîncercare ${taskName}: ${retries} rămase`); return persistentRetry(taskName, fn, retries - 1); } localStorage.setItem(`failed_${taskName}`, JSON.stringify({ error: e.message, ts: Date.now() })); return null; } };

Subiect: Scoped API keys: a change coming on 2 December

Conținut:
From 2 December, new API keys need an explicit scope list. Here’s what changes.  ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

https://deepinfra.com November 2026

DeepInfra has rolled out scoped API keys! Below: what scopes do, a change to key creation coming on 2 December, and how to limit the keys you already have.
API key scopes


** Scoped API keys are live.
------------------------------------------------------------

Since 3 November, you can specify scopes when you create an API key. Scopes limit the actions that key can successfully perform.

Every existing scope is described in our documentation. In the API reference, each endpoint that accepts API key authentication is annotated with the scope it needs. Scoped JWTs created from an API key are limited to the scopes of the key that created them.

See all scopes → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/account/authentication#scopes)

Example endpoint in the API reference → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/api-reference/account/me)
Change on 2 December


** Key creation will require a scope list.
------------------------------------------------------------

In the first days after the rollout, requests to create an API key with no scopes specified were accepted, and those keys were made unrestricted. An unrestricted key has every non-sensitive scope, including scopes we add later.

In two weeks, on 2 December, API key creation requests that don’t specify scopes will be rejected. If you still need unrestricted behavior, send an explicit scope list of ["unrestricted"]. unrestricted has to be the only value in the list, or the request fails with a 422. These calls are already supported today, so you can update your integration now.

More on unrestricted keys → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/account/authentication#unrestricted-keys)
Existing keys


** You can edit a key’s scopes.
------------------------------------------------------------

A key’s scopes are editable. Keys created before scopes existed are unrestricted. To limit one, open it in API key management in the DeepInfra dashboard, switch it to Scoped, and pick the scopes it needs.

https://deepinfra.com November 2026

DeepInfra has rolled out scoped API keys! Below: what scopes do, a change to key creation coming on 2 December, and how to limit the keys you already have.
API key scopes


** Scoped API keys are live.
------------------------------------------------------------

Since 3 November, you can specify scopes when you create an API key. Scopes limit the actions that key can successfully perform.

Every existing scope is described in our documentation. In the API reference, each endpoint that accepts API key authentication is annotated with the scope it needs. Scoped JWTs created from an API key are limited to the scopes of the key that created them.

Example endpoint in the API reference → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/api-reference/account/me)
Change on 2 December


** Key creation will require a scope list.
------------------------------------------------------------

In the first days after the rollout, requests to create an API key with no scopes specified were accepted, and those keys were made unrestricted. An unrestricted key has every non-sensitive scope, including scopes we add later.

In two weeks, on 2 December, API key creation requests that don’t specify scopes will be rejected. If you still need unrestricted behavior, send an explicit scope list of ["unrestricted"]. unrestricted has to be the only value in the list, or the request fails with a 422. These calls are already supported today, so you can update your integration now.

More on unrestricted keys → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/account/authentication#unrestricted-keys)
Existing keys


** You can edit a key’s scopes.
------------------------------------------------------------

A key’s scopes are editable. Keys created before scopes existed are unrestricted. To limit one, open it in API key management in the DeepInfra dashboard, switch it to Scoped, and pick the scopes it needs.

Payment methods

(Link checkout showing Instant Bank Payments, cards, Pix, and UPI as payment options [https://b.stripecdn.com/link-email/assets/ibp_credit_pix_upi.png]) A customer can choose their preferred payment methods.
